criteria.requirement: Describe Jinja as a text-template engine, with loader, Environment compilation/cache, Template, context, inheritance and filters in the supplied render path. It is usable without Flask.
Explain that rendering produces new text; it is not a lossless frontmatter or Markdown source editor. Keep source files unchanged.

comparison: Evaluate supported behavior, constraints and delivered evidence, not keywords, verbosity or reference-answer similarity.
